# The Old Farmer's Almanac

> > America's oldest continuously published periodical, providing recipes, gardening advice, weather forecasts, and traditional wisdom since 1792.

Founded by Robert B. Thomas, The Old Farmer's Almanac has served readers for over two centuries with practical advice, seasonal recipes, and folklore. The site features traditional New England recipes from Yankee Magazine, regional inns and B&Bs, and time-tested cooking methods passed down through generations.

## Key Topics

- The Old Farmer's Almanac

## Breakfast & Brunch Recipes

- [Avocado Quiche](https://www.almanac.com/recipe/avocado-quiche): Avocado quiche breakfast recipe from Holland Inn, Bar Harbor, Maine
- [Fresh Basil and Tomato Frittata](https://www.almanac.com/recipe/fresh-basil-and-tomato-frittata): Vermont cheddar frittata with basil and tomato from Henry Farm Inn
- [Pumpkin Ginger Muffins](https://www.almanac.com/recipe/pumpkin-ginger-muffins): Fall pumpkin ginger muffins from The Maine Stay, Kennebunkport
- [Sausage Gravy](https://www.almanac.com/recipe/sausage-gravy): Southern-style sausage gravy comfort food breakfast recipe
- [Apple Cider Bread or Muffins](https://www.almanac.com/recipe/apple-cider-bread-or-muffins): Apple cider quickbread recipe from Red Lion Inn, Stockbridge MA
- [Lemon Blueberry Bread](https://www.almanac.com/recipe/lemon-blueberry-bread): Blue ribbon lemon blueberry quickbread by Karen Jean Kotick, Ohio

## Desserts & Baked Goods

- [Beignets](https://www.almanac.com/recipe/beignets): New Orleans-style deep-fried beignets with yeast dough recipe
- [Cranberry-Pistachio Biscotti](https://www.almanac.com/recipe/cranberry-pistachio-biscotti): Cranberry-pistachio biscotti cookie recipe from Yankee Magazine
- [Old-Fashioned Gingerbread](https://www.almanac.com/recipe/old-fashioned-gingerbread): Traditional molasses gingerbread cake with cinnamon and ginger spices
- [Ethel Wallace's White Mountain Frosting](https://www.almanac.com/recipe/ethel-wallaces-white-mountain-frosting): New England boiled egg white frosting recipe by Ethel Wallace
- [Cranberry Pie](https://www.almanac.com/recipe/cranberry-pie-1): Double-crust cranberry pie dessert for holiday entertaining
- [Applesauce Cake](https://www.almanac.com/recipe/applesauce-cake): User-submitted spiced applesauce cake recipe from Old Farmer's Almanac
